finalist.closure_form: a: two explicitly paired ordered orientation members with a prospectively derived quotient equal to the Reynolds one-half average
finalist.justification_frozen: The discrete quadrature graph is not R-symmetric: legs 1,2 are native nodal evaluations, legs 3,4 are interpolated off-node evaluations. A proved exact R-bijection of one discrete sample set (form b) would require a special sample set departing from the structure under test and risks a wrong-quotient artifact. Form (a) matches F-OPEN-CROSS-ADMIT-003 verbatim.
finalist.member_roles: Each member is evaluated in its own event loop with its own native-incoming legs 1,2 (direct nodal lookup) and interpolated-outgoing legs 3,4 (Lagrange interpolation through the native nodes).

quotient.derivation: Orbit-stabilizer for the free Z2 action generated by sigma = P.R (P: mu/tau label permutation; R: slot involution (1,2)<->(3,4)). sigma maps M_PLUS <-> M_MINUS, the stabilizer of each member is trivial, so the Reynolds operator is (1/|Z2|) * sum over the group = (1/2)(id + sigma). Executable witness: Reynolds idempotence Close(Close(cat)) == Close(cat) in exact rational arithmetic; q=1 and q=1/4 fail 2*q^2 == q.
quotient.not_fitted: q is fixed here, before any output, and is never tuned to covariance or any observable.

sign_product.drive: D = (1-f1)(1-f2)*f3*f4 - f1*f2*(1-f3)*(1-f4); legs 1,2 deposit +D, legs 3,4 deposit -D (scaled by quadrature weight and kernel)
sign_product.equivalent_form_check: (-,-,+,+) x loss-minus-gain must be bitwise identical (A9)

manufactured_family.nonphysical_declaration: All spectra, kernels, grids, and outputs are manufactured and nonphysical. No G_F, no m_e, no Minkowski dots, no physical collision action, rate, or N_eff is computed or emitted. No rabbit.* module is imported.
manufactured_family.occupations: dyadic-rational polynomials of degree <= 2, strictly inside (0,1) on [0,4]
manufactured_family.kernel: W(y1,y2,t) = y1^2 * y2^2 * t * (1-t) (manufactured positive kernel)
manufactured_family.outgoing_map: y3 = t*(y1+y2), y4 = (1-t)*(y1+y2), t in {1/4, 1/2, 3/4}; support mask 0 < y3 < 4 and 0 < y4 < 4, strict, identical across members

engines.E_RAT: exact Fraction arithmetic; frozen dyadic nodes {1/2, 3/2, 5/2, 7/2}, weights {1,1,1,1}
engines.E_FLT_MIRROR: binary64 mirror of E_RAT (same nodes/weights as floats); used for the cross-engine agreement bound
engines.E_FLT_GL8: binary64 Gauss-Legendre 8-node rule mapped to [0,4]; used for bitwise equivariance, sweep, and structural checks

manufactured_family.modal_basis: b_k(y) = LegendreP_k(y/2 - 1), k = 0..3 (rational values at rational y); diagonal Gram h_k = 4/(2k+1); pre-native modal coefficient vectors are the primary observables, compared before any 1/y^2 native map (the native map appears only inside MUT-6)

acceptance_battery.A2_single_member_fails: E_RAT residual C_single(Pf; M_PLUS) - P.C_single(f; M_PLUS) is exactly nonzero on the asymmetric fixture (negative control); E_FLT_MIRROR residual agrees with the rational residual within the agreement bound.
acceptance_battery.A3_closed_equivariance: C_closed(Pf) == P.C_closed(f): exact Fraction equality on E_RAT; bitwise float equality on E_FLT_GL8 and E_FLT_MIRROR (shared-evaluator symmetry C_single(Pf; M_PLUS) === P.C_single(f; M_MINUS)).
acceptance_battery.A4_quotient_idempotence: reynolds(reynolds(cat)) == reynolds(cat) exactly for cat = {M_PLUS: 1}; 2*q^2 == q holds only for q = 1/2 among {1, 1/2, 1/4}.
acceptance_battery.A5_antisymmetric_response: S_anti(asymmetric fixture) != 0 exactly (E_RAT); S_anti(symmetric fixture) == 0 exactly (E_RAT); float value within agreement bound of the rational value. No tuned magnitude threshold.
acceptance_battery.A6_conservation_entropy: E_RAT: sum_a N_a == 0 exactly and sum_a E_a == 0 exactly (uses y3+y4 = y1+y2). E_FLT: pair-summed number (N_mu + N_tau) + (N_mubar + N_taubar) == 0.0 bitwise (equal-magnitude cancellation through b_0 == 1 within each mu/tau pair); |sum_a E_a| <= 1e-11 * (sum_a |E_a| + 2^-40). Entropy certificate per event, exact: D_dep * (G_gain - G_loss) >= 0 with G_gain, G_loss recomputed independently in the test from the event trace, and strictly > 0 for at least one event on the asymmetric fixture.
acceptance_battery.A7_jvp: Dual-number (Fraction) JVP with tangent delta-f_mu(y) = y/256: eps(C_closed) == q*(eps(C_M_PLUS) + eps(C_M_MINUS)) exactly, and eps(C_closed) != q*eps(C_M_PLUS) (dropped-member JVP differs exactly), and eps(C_M_MINUS) != 0.
acceptance_battery.A8_mutants: Every mutant in mutant_battery fails its preregistered assertion for its preregistered reason; a mutant that passes, or that fails only with a mechanical error unrelated to its preregistered assertion, discards the package.
acceptance_battery.A9_equivalent_form: sign_form='lmg_mmpp' output bitwise identical to frozen 'gml_pppp_mm' on all engines.
acceptance_battery.A10_determinism: scrambled event-generation order produces bitwise-identical output (canonical sort before reduction); 4096-case counter-derived dyadic sweep on E_FLT_GL8 each passing bitwise A3 and structural number null; primary run and two fresh-process replays byte-identical on {RESULTS.json, MUTANTS.json}.

tolerances.exact: All E_RAT checks are exact Fraction equalities/inequalities.
tolerances.bitwise: A3/A9/A10 float checks are bitwise (==) on binary64.
tolerances.agreement_bound: per modal entry |float - rational| / max(|rational|, 2^-40) <= 1e-11, derived prospectively from an operation-count forward-error estimate (< 1e4 binary64 ops per entry x 2.22e-16 unit roundoff, margin > 4x); all lab inputs are dyadic so float conversion is exact.
tolerances.no_post_hoc: No tolerance, factor, quotient, or normalization may be changed after the first sealed execution.

sweep.coefficients: per species s in 0..3 of case n: m = 4n + s; c0 = 1/4 + (m mod 8)/32; c1 = ((m div 8) mod 8 - 4)/256; c2 = ((m div 64) mod 4)/1024; guarantees f in (9/64, 37/64) on [0,4]

execution_protocol.entry_point: ./run_lab.sh with zero arguments; any argument aborts with exit 30
execution_protocol.seal: The lab directory (6 authored files) is committed to local git BEFORE the first execution; run_lab.sh verifies the authored-file SHA-256 set against MANIFEST_AUTHORED.sha256 and records {contract_sha256, git_head, utc_time, uid, tool_versions} in raw/SEAL_CHRONOLOGY.json. Local git commit replaces D-042R GitHub commit pinning (LOCAL-ADAPT under D-045).
execution_protocol.isolation: run_lab.sh re-executes the inner runner under unshare -rn (user+net namespaces); the inner runner performs negative network probes (connect to 127.0.0.1:9 and 8.8.8.8:53 must fail) recorded in raw/ISOLATION.json; missing unshare or a successful probe aborts with exit 30. Digest-pinned OCI image is unsatisfiable locally and is replaced by exact runtime version assertion (LOCAL-ADAPT).
execution_protocol.replays: primary + two fresh-process replays, each fully isolated; byte-comparison set {RESULTS.json, MUTANTS.json}; canonical JSON (sorted keys, repr floats, Fractions as 'p/q'), no timestamps in the comparison set
execution_protocol.source_immutability: pre/post SHA-256 comparison of the 6 authored files around every run; mutation during run aborts with exit 30
execution_protocol.raw_logs: full stdout/stderr of every process under raw/
execution_protocol.manifest: MANIFEST.sha256 generated last over every file in the lab directory except itself
